messages:
aria: HelioHealth POC seeing intermittent SSE truncation on Android SDK v0.9.3 during staging demos. Truncated events -> org.json.JSONException. Demo tomorrow AM — need triage.

samir: Which route/model and any client stack?

aria: route: POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b. Client: "org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object at character 1023". Server log shows stream_chunk_incomplete for some conns.

pria: please paste the server snippet and topology.

aria: server snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:11Z INF client=helio/staging conn=abcd1234 bytes_sent=6248
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end="\n\n"
```
Topology: mobile -> company NAT -> CDN -> app gateway -> our edge. Direct-to-edge reduced failures but not zero.

josh: likely proxy/CDN flush splitting UTF-8 multibyte boundaries or mid-event flush. Two immediate mitigations: (1) client buffer until full SSE event delimiter (\n\n) and use incremental UTF-8 decoder; (2) server append a small sentinel event after logical chunks.

samir: I can hot-toggle a per-route flag send_fragment_sentinel=true to append `event: fragment_end\ndata: {\"last\":true}\n\n` after chunks. Low risk. Also recommend route keepalive=15s to reduce intermediate flushes.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio].

aria: customer approved the toggle for staging. Samir toggled at 2026-03-18T15:12Z.

aria: after toggle they ran 20+ sessions: direct-edge = no parse errors; CDN path failures dropped dramatically (~1/300). Demo remains GO.

pria: follow-ups: INF-7243 (runtime sentinel + admin UI), INF-7244 (eng-sdk Android incremental UTF-8), INF-7245 (platform route keepalive override).

kendall-sales: I'll update Helio: applied low-risk server toggle, SDK guidance and timeline provided, will discuss dedicated capacity options for long-term stability.

aria: closing loop with customer, scheduling post-demo retrospective. :white_check_mark:
